'''Mashallon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as an investigator during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
In [[3643 BBY]], Mashallon was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] on the behalf of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nomen Karr]] to investigate an Imperial spy in the Republic ranks stationed there. She recorded a conversation between an undercover [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial spy]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rylon (spy)|Rylon]] and the [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] that confirmed Rylon's duplicity and threatened to expose Baras' network of spies. Unfortunately for her, the Imperials became aware of her presence and blocked her attempts to reach her ship, forcing her to head to Sobrik Spaceport to find another. She was cornered by the Sith Warrior in [[Hangar 61]] of the [[Sobrik Spaceport]] and engaged them in a duel, boasting that Baras already lost, as the incriminating information has been sent off-world. She urged the Warrior to abandon the dark side and find redemption, but the Sith ignored her and attacked. Mashallon defended herself and, despite believing that the Sith Warrior's adherence to the dark side made them weak, her opponent was able to overpower her. Left at the Sith's mercy, she openly welcomed death, believing she had finally struck a blow against the Empire, only for Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Malavai Quinn]] to arrive with a squad of troopers, revealing that he had intercepted her transmission, keeping the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] in the dark. Despite her failure, Mashallon promised that Karr and his Padawan would defeat Baras and his apprentice, after which the Warrior executed her.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mashallon is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. She is voiced by [[Kath Soucie]].<ref name="TOR" />

The player can choose to either kill Mashallon or order to take her into custody.<ref name="TOR" />
